title: Attacker url observed in the wild: https://wrpddqm0rp.rbmock.dev/ (OffSeq Mirage)
description: An attacker URL https://wrpddqm0rp.rbmock.dev/ was observed in the wild by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-10-24.
